modelOverview: The Santos de Cartier Medium is the mid-size iteration of the house's pioneering 1904 pilot's watch, relaunched in its current form in 2018 with the in-house automatic Calibre 1847 MC and the signature QuickSwitch/SmartLink interchangeable bracelet system. Its square bezel, exposed screws and Roman numeral dial remain unchanged from Louis Cartier's original design for aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont, making it one of the most recognisable case shapes in watchmaking.

WSSA0020.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · ~48h power reserve
WSSA0020.bezel: Steel bezel with exposed signature screws
WSSA0020.dial: Silvered opaline dial with black Roman numerals, railway minute track and blued-steel sword hands
WSSA0020.description: A steel Medium Santos de Cartier with the classic silvered opaline dial that defines the model's post-2018 relaunch. It carries the in-house automatic Calibre 1847 MC, the QuickSwitch interchangeable bracelet system with steel SmartLink links, and is fully sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Silver Dial: All-steel Medium Santos with the standard silvered opaline dial, black Roman numerals and blued-steel hands on the steel SmartLink bracelet with an interchangeable calfskin strap included.

W2SA0011.materials: Stainless steel case with 18k rose gold (750/1000) bezel
W2SA0011.bezel: 18k rose gold bezel with exposed signature screws
W2SA0011.dial: Satin-brushed silver dial with sunray effect, black Roman numerals and blued-steel sword hands
W2SA0011.description: Note: this reference corresponds to the Santos-Dumont Large model in the official Cartier catalogue (steel case with 18k rose gold bezel, quartz movement) rather than an automatic Santos de Cartier Medium in steel and gold; specification below reflects the verified, publicly documented facts for reference W2SA0011 itself, sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel & Gold: Steel case with 18k rose gold bezel and crown, satin-brushed silver sunray dial with Roman numerals, on a black alligator leather strap with a steel ardillon buckle.

WSSA0063.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · ~40h power reserve
WSSA0063.materials: Stainless steel case and bracelet; second strap in blue alligator leather with interchangeable folding steel buckle (QuickSwitch)
WSSA0063.bezel: Steel bezel with exposed signature screws
WSSA0063.dial: Graduated blue dial with Roman numerals and polished steel sword-shaped hands with luminescent material
WSSA0063.description: Note: Cartier lists reference WSSA0063 as the Medium (35.1mm) Santos de Cartier with a graduated blue dial, rather than a Large model with a black dial; the dial shades to near-black at its edge. It carries the in-house automatic Calibre 1847 MC and is supplied with the SmartLink steel bracelet and a blue alligator strap on the QuickSwitch system, fully sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Blue Dial: Medium steel Santos de Cartier with the graduated blue dial that darkens towards the edge, luminous sword hands and a 7-sided spinel-set crown, on the interchangeable steel bracelet with a blue alligator strap.

WSSA0065.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · ~42h power reserve
WSSA0065.materials: Stainless steel case and bracelet; second strap in brown alligator leather with interchangeable folding steel buckle (QuickSwitch)

WSSA0065.description: Note: Cartier documents reference WSSA0065 as the Medium (35.1mm) Santos de Cartier with a graduated brown sunray dial rather than a Large night-blue model. The dial shades from a warm centre to a dark rim beneath the squared, screwed bezel, and the watch runs the automatic Calibre 1847 MC with the SmartLink bracelet and a brown alligator strap included, fully sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Brown Dial: Medium steel Santos de Cartier with the graduated brown sunray dial (documented by Cartier as brown rather than night blue), luminous rhodium-finish sword hands and spinel-set crown, on the interchangeable steel bracelet with a brown alligator strap.
